data_description.radio_id_aliases: Map renamed runtime radio IDs to their previous Home Assistant IDs using a JSON object, for example source local mapped to target radio0. Confirm that each pair is the same physical radio. IDs are case-sensitive and are not device names. Use an empty JSON object to clear aliases. IDs must be nonempty strings without whitespace. Targets must be unique; chains, cycles, and simultaneous source/target runtime IDs are not allowed. A target may return on its own. Saving reloads the integration. See the operational monitoring documentation for JSON examples and radio retirement behavior.

error.invalid_radio_aliases: Enter a JSON object mapping runtime IDs to previous Home Assistant IDs. Use unique nonempty strings without whitespace, no duplicate keys or targets, and no chains, cycles, or targets already used by runtime radios. Use {} to clear aliases.
